summary: Appendix part 1 (book pp.208-209): recognising the structure of speculative stocks (投机股), using 普格 2012 daily. Watch price-volume and chip data (融券/margin short, 融资, main-player 库存): a short squeeze timed to shareholder-meeting forced covering, short interest rising while price fails to rise after a breakout (main player shorting), and inventory collapsing on rebounds. Strict stops and decisively exiting when price-volume goes wrong avoid the later collapse or delisting.

patterns.name_zh: 投机股结构（轧空 / 融券异常 / 库存下降）
patterns.name_en: Speculative-stock structure: squeeze, abnormal short interest, falling insider inventory
patterns.structure: Sharp rally with rising short interest; main player forces a squeeze before the April shareholder meetings (forced covering). After a volume breakout of the range high (7/20), short interest rises fast while price doesn't rise = main player is shorting. Then a long black candle breaks the line (7/30), more than 5 limit-downs, heavy volume, quick short covering.
patterns.entry: Exit longs (avoidance rule, not a short setup): when price breaks the short-term low after the heavy-volume crash (17.35) without regaining the volume-day high (20.35).
patterns.stop: For longs: the low after a heavy-volume decline must not be broken; breaking it is the last stop chance.
confirmation: 融券余额 above the average daily volume but price falls instead of squeezing
Heavy-volume line break of the rebound head (12/26) plus two days of abnormal drops in inventory

rules.rule: Watching price-volume structure avoids most speculative-stock risk; strict stops and decisive exit when price-volume goes wrong avoid later problems up to delisting.
rules.quote_zh: 注意量价结构大多可以避开投机股的风险，我操作股票以来，难以避免也接触过投机股，但都因为坚持严设停损而能避开风险。……认识投机的结构后当量价出现问题时毅然退出，便能避开该股票随后发生的问题，甚至是退市。

rules.rule: Stocks that fall back to the launch point after a squeeze are mostly speculative.
rules.quote_zh: 通常轧完空后会跌回起涨点的股票大多属投机性质。

rules.rule: Short interest rising fast (above average daily volume) while price fails to rise after a breakout is abnormal — the main player is shorting.
rules.quote_zh: 融券快速增加但价却不涨的异常现象，融券余额已超过日均量，具备轧空条件，但价不涨反跌便是异常，属主力放空现象。

rules.rule: Rising price + rising short interest: the main player usually squeezes retail shorts; falling price + rising short interest: usually the main player is shorting.
rules.quote_zh: （价涨券增通常主力轧散户空，价跌券增通常是主力做空）

rules.rule: The low after a heavy-volume decline should not be broken; if the rebound fails below the volume-day high and price breaks that low, it is the last stop for longs — exit decisively.
rules.quote_zh: 当回跌再破17.35元低点的时候，便是多头最后的停损机会（通常下跌大量后的低点不能再破）

rules.rule: A heavy-volume line break of the rebound confirms a head; that day's high becomes resistance. Abnormal drops in inventory usually mean the company or major holders are selling.
rules.quote_zh: 12月26日爆量破线头部确立，当日高点6.95元成为反弹结束后的反压，重点是当时连续两日的库存余额异常大减，通常都是公司派或大股东积极出脱持股

rules.rule: Insiders know first (春江冷暖鸭先知): persistent falling inventory after a crash means doubts are growing, not fading.
rules.quote_zh: “春江冷暖鸭先知”，可见此股长期疑虑在股价崩跌后仍不减反增。

worked_examples.pattern: 投机股结构：轧空 → 融券异常 → 跌停崩跌 → 库存下降

levels.fraud_impact: 4.6亿 on 5.79亿 capital, up to 7.9 EPS loss

worked_examples.outcome: Squeeze in April around shareholder meetings; after 7/20 short interest rose while price fell; 7/30 crash with >5 limit-downs; October fraud news → ~20 limit-downs to 3.73 with margin longs force-liquidated; 12/26 head at 6.95 never retaken; 2013-03-04 another limit-down collapse.

quantifiable: Abnormal short interest: short balance > average daily volume AND close lower N days after a range breakout → avoid/exit.
Post-crash stop: after a heavy-volume decline, record the next swing low L and the volume-day high H; if a rebound fails below H and close < L → exit.
Squeeze-reversal speculative tag: price returns to the rally's launch level after a squeeze.
Insider-selling alert: main-player inventory drops abnormally on two consecutive days, then trends down.
ambiguities: 'Abnormal' inventory drop and 'rapid' short-interest increase are not quantified.
The appendix is about avoiding speculative stocks; no explicit short-entry rule is given.
Chip data (融券, 融资, 库存余额) is Taiwan-specific; how to map it to US data is not addressed.
